messages.subject: Offset ignored in geom_fruit with position_dodge2
parts: Hello, I’m trying to plot a barplot with two statistics to the right of my tree. When I set the position to “dodge2” to separate the bars into two, the position of the plot is to the left (and overtopping) the phylogenetic tree, and the offset to move the barplot is ignored. Any help is greatly appreciated!
